what: DAILY-DD-SWITCH equity resolution gap on NON-Bybit accounts (alpaca_live is real money): the coordinator feeds a live TOTAL equity only for Bybit linear (totalEquity, coordinator _fetch_linear_total_equity); 7 of 13 non-retired accounts (alpaca_paper, alpaca_portfolio, alpaca_live, alpaca_options_paper, ib_paper, ib_live, oanda_practice) fall back to runtime_logs/balance_snapshots.json, written HOURLY by hourly_report, accepted up to 2h old. So (a) intraday the switch can see a 3% loss up to ~1h late and trip well past 3%, (b) day-start equity is the last hourly reading within 2h before 00:00 UTC, (c) the reset alert fires on the first evaluation of the new day, not at the boundary. Fix: feed each broker's live account equity (Alpaca /v2/account equity, IB NetLiquidation) into RiskManager.note_live_equity per dispatch, same basis day-start and current; add a per-tick observe so the reset/trip alerts do not wait for a signal.
